t: What Microbiome Function Database Is All About
title: What Microbiome Function Database Is All About
description: Microbiomes are communities doing chemistry: gut bacteria ferment fiber into short-chain fatty acids (butyrate feeds colon cells), soil microbes fix nitrogen for plants, and ocean plankton drive half of Earth's oxygen. The human gut holds ~38 trillion microbes — roughly as many as human cells. Function follows community: diversity generally means resilience, and antibiotics can collapse both. This database is the complete microbiome function: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
definition: Microbiome Function Database: a complete reference database of full microbiome function records.
